I Hear Them All by Old Crow Medicine Show

Transcribed by DWdrummer67. Please rank this contribution. Thanks.

This is a great tune... enjoy!

Tuning: Standard (Capo 2nd fret)
Key of A 
Harmonica is in Key of A

[Intro with Harmonica]
(Three strokes on high E, third fret)
[ch]C[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch]  [ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]
[ch]G[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]D[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]

[Verse 1]
[tab]             [ch]C[/ch]                            [ch]G[/ch]
I hear the crying of the hungry in the deserts where they're wandering[/tab]
[tab]            [ch]D[/ch]                             [ch]G[/ch]
Hear them crying out for heaven’s own benevolence upon them[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]C[/ch]                                 [ch]G[/ch]
Hear destructive power prevailing, I hear fools falsely hailing[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]G[/ch]              [ch]D[/ch]               [ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch]
To the crooked wits of tyrants when they call[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]G[/ch]                [ch]D[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]
I hear them all, I hear them all, I hear them all[/tab]

[Verse 2]
[tab]             [ch]C[/ch]                              [ch]G[/ch]
I hear the sounds of tearing pages and the roar of burning paper[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]D[/ch]                             [ch]G[/ch]
All the crimes and acquisition turn to air and ashen vapor[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]C[/ch]                         [ch]G[/ch]
And the rattle of the shackle far beyond emancipator[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]G[/ch]           [ch]D[/ch]               [ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch]
And the lowliest to gather in their stalls[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]G[/ch]                [ch]D[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]
I hear them all, I hear them all, I hear them all[/tab]

[Musical Interlude with Harmonica] (verse progression)
[ch]G[/ch] [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
[ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]C[/ch]
[ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]

[Verse 2]
[tab]              [ch]C[/ch]                                [ch]G[/ch]
So while you sit and whistle dixie with your money and your power[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]D[/ch]                                   [ch]G[/ch]
I can hear the flowers a-growing in the rubble of the towers[/tab]
[tab]         [ch]C[/ch]                                [ch]G[/ch]
I hear leaders quit their lying, I hear babies quit their crying[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]G[/ch]                 [ch]D[/ch]            [ch]Em[/ch]    [ch]C[/ch]
I hear soldiers quit their dying one and all[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]G[/ch]                [ch]D[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]
I hear them all, I hear them all, I hear them all[/tab]

[Musical Interlude with Harmonica] (verse progression)
[ch]G[/ch] [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
[ch]G[/ch] [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]C[/ch]
[ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]

[Verse 3]       
[tab]             [ch]C[/ch]                              [ch]G[/ch]
I hear the tender words from Zion, I hear Noah's waterfall[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]D[/ch]                           [ch]G[/ch]
Hear the gentle lamb of Judah sleeping at the feet of Buddha[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]C[/ch]                         [ch]G[/ch]
And the prophets from Elijah to the old Paiute Wovoka[/tab]
[tab]              [ch]G[/ch]            [ch]D[/ch]                  [ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch]
Take their places at the table when they're called[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]G[/ch]                [ch]D[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]
I hear them all, I hear them all, I hear them all[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]G[/ch]                [ch]D[/ch]               [ch]Em[/ch]            [ch]C[/ch]
I hear them all, I hear them all, I hear them all… (raise vocal pitch)[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]G[/ch]                [ch]D[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]     [ch]G[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
I hear them all, I hear them all, I hear them all…[/tab]
